CLT010.styleNotes: Navy with sheen feels like a tailored tee; ideal with wool trousers.
CLT010.fitNotes: Boxy and cropped enough to show waistband details.

CLT011.name: Cove Limited Mercerized Tee
CLT011.description: Stone beige mercerized tee with a softer lifestyle tone and limited hem branding.

care.careNotes: Wash similar colors together; avoid harsh detergents.

CLT011.styleNotes: Earth tone and sheen make it easy to build tonal outfits.
CLT011.fitNotes: Same Limited tee block; choose based on color palette.

CLT012.name: Cove Limited Mercerized Tee
CLT012.description: Deep burgundy Limited tee when you want a richer, drop-feeling color story.

care.careNotes: Wash inside out with dark colors; tumble dry low.

CLT012.styleNotes: Deep burgundy becomes the focal point in otherwise neutral outfits.
CLT012.fitNotes: Boxy, cropped; looks good with wide or tapered trousers.

CLB013.name: Cove Limited Wool-Leather Bomber
CLB013.description: Black Limited bomber with wool body and faux leather sleeves, designed as a statement piece.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; avoid folding sleeves sharply to preserve faux leather.

CLB013.styleNotes: Classic varsity-inspired shape but in a cleaner, monochrome execution.
CLB013.fitNotes: Regular bomber block; designed to sit at waist with ribbed hem.

CLB014.name: Cove Limited Wool-Leather Bomber
CLB014.description: Charcoal Limited bomber with contrast black faux leather sleeves and tonal embroidery.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; store on a broad hanger to maintain shoulders.

CLB014.styleNotes: Feels like a limited varsity piece but executed in a minimal COVE way.
CLB014.fitNotes: Regular bomber fit, room for a hoodie or tee underneath.

CLB015.name: Cove Limited Wool-Leather Bomber
CLB015.description: Ink navy Limited bomber with tonal faux leather sleeves and minimal chest logo.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; avoid crushing sleeves under heavy items.

CLB015.styleNotes: Navy wool and tonal leather feel slightly softer than full black but still premium.
CLB015.fitNotes: Same Limited bomber block; choose by color story.

CLB016.name: Cove Limited Wool-Leather Bomber
CLB016.description: Stone grey Limited bomber with black faux leather sleeves and tonal embroidery.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; store in breathable garment bag.

CLB016.styleNotes: Stone grey body with black sleeves gives a more modern varsity look.
CLB016.fitNotes: Regular bomber fit; ribbed hem and cuffs keep it neat.

CLJ017.name: Cove Limited Wool-Cashmere Coat
CLJ017.description: Charcoal Limited wool-cashmere coat with clean front, hidden buttons and minimal branding.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; hang on a broad hanger and avoid overstuffing closets.

CLJ017.styleNotes: Minimal detailing keeps the coat timeless and lets the fabric speak.
CLJ017.fitNotes: Regular coat block; room for a knit or hoodie underneath.

CLJ018.name: Cove Limited Wool-Cashmere Coat
CLJ018.description: Camel Limited wool-cashmere coat for sharper, more statement winter looks.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; protect from friction of rough bags to avoid pilling.

CLJ018.styleNotes: Camel reads very luxury; pairs well with dark trousers and clean sneakers or boots.
CLJ018.fitNotes: Same cut as CLJ017; choose based on color and how loud you want the coat to feel.

CLJ019.name: Cove Limited Wool-Cashmere Coat
CLJ019.description: Ink navy Limited wool-cashmere coat bridging tailoring and modern streetwear.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; hang to air out between wears instead of over-washing.

CLJ019.styleNotes: Navy outerwear is easier to wear daily than black but still sharp.
CLJ019.fitNotes: Regular block; sits clean over hoodies, knitwear or tees.

CLJ020.name: Cove Limited Wool-Cashmere Coat
CLJ020.description: Soft grey Limited wool-cashmere coat for very clean, minimal winter outfits.

care.careNotes: Dry-clean only; avoid rough backpack straps that can damage the surface.

CLJ020.styleNotes: Soft grey outerwear photographs and reads very modern, perfect for a Limited drop.
CLJ020.fitNotes: Same coat block as other Limited coats; sizing is primarily about layering preference.

CLT101.name: Cove Limited Graphic Tee
CLT101.description: Limited tee with a numbered graphic print and boxy block.

care.careNotes: Wash inside out; avoid direct iron on the print.

CLT101.styleNotes: Limited print and heavier weight clearly communicate a drop piece.
CLT101.fitNotes: Boxy; designed to sit above the hips.

CLB102.name: Cove Limited Leather Bomber
CLB102.description: Limited faux leather bomber with a minimal, luxury-leaning execution.

care.careNotes: Avoid heat and strong solvents; wipe with a damp cloth.

CLB102.styleNotes: Reads as a proper Limited drop leather piece but keeps the faux-leather ethics.
CLB102.fitNotes: Regular bomber block; works well over tees and knits.
